name: robot-api
author: octos
description: Send natural-language robot commands directly to the AKA-00 car via HTTP. Supports 前进/后退/左转/右转/停止/抓取/释放 with optional speed and time.

tools.name: robot_control
tools.description: Send a natural-language robot control command to the AKA-00 car via HTTP. Constructs the full URL from the provided IP and makes a GET request. Returns the car's response. Supports actions: 前进(up), 后退(down), 左转(left), 右转(right), 停止(stop), 抓取(grab), 释放(release). Optionally accepts speed (0-50) and time (in milliseconds).

ip.description: The IP address of the car, e.g. 192.168.0.107

action.description: The robot action in Chinese or English. Valid: 前进/up, 后退/down, 左转/left, 右转/right, 停止/stop, 抓取/grab, 释放/release

time.description: Optional duration in milliseconds, e.g. 10000 for 10 seconds
